name: Extract Comprehensive Science Section
prompt:
From exam_review_workspace/高三上期中全科深度复盘与错题集.docx on the desktop, extract all content starting from the level-1 heading “三、理综失分点剖析与变式训练” up to but not including the level-1 heading “四、英语作文高频句型”, save it as a new document named 《期中理综错题特训.docx》, and put it in the same folder.

In the extracted content, the parts highlighted in red in the original text must keep their colors. For the comprehensive science part, the chemistry equations, force analysis tables, images, and formulas must all be fully retained without misalignment or omission. The first paragraph of the new document (that is, the comprehensive science main heading) must keep the original “标题 1” style.
